allowed_uses: development of fail-closed synthetic input handling

limitations: The boundary is deliberately narrower than full FHIR R4 and CARIN conformance.
CARIN errors and warnings are diagnostic compatibility evidence and do not decide minimal-profile acceptance.
System URIs, codes, displays, identifiers, extensions, and references outside required integrity checks remain opaque untrusted source data.
Unverified terminology may be displayed and investigated but cannot independently justify a domain conclusion.
The source is not approved for benchmark freeze, public redistribution, production, or real-world outcome claims.
